name: session-capsule
description: Move an unfinished coding task between computers: pack the conversation, a continuation note and project files into one verified capsule, then preview and import it on the other machine.

interface.shortDescription: Move a task to another computer
interface.longDescription: Packs the conversation, a continuation note and project files into one verified capsule. On the other computer it previews, imports with conflict review and backups, and hands the context to a new session.
defaultPrompt: Pack this task so I can finish it on my other computer.
Preview importing this capsule into this project.
Continue the task from the capsule that was imported here.
